atom.claim: AMBIT团队被训练发展并维持一种地方文化，明确寻求在三个额外象限（与团队合作、与更广泛网络合作、在工作中学习）与传统的直接面对客户的工作之间取得平衡。
therapeutic_implications: 团队应平衡关注客户、团队、网络和学习四个象限
atom.evidence_excerpt: AMBIT teams are trained to help develop and maintain a local culture that explicitly seeks to balance attention between three extra “quadrants” in our work, in addition to the more conventional focus on direct face-to-face “working with the client”. These other three quadrants are represented in the AMBIT wheel (Figure 12.1): • Working with the Team • Working with wider Networks • Learning at Work
atom.extraction_notes: 原文明确描述了AMBIT的四个象限。

atom.claim: 在这一工作领域，工作者可能经历独特的专业羞耻感脆弱性，羞耻感倾向于减少工作者的求助行为，使他们更容易孤立并进一步崩溃其脆弱的心智化能力。
clinical_signals: 工作者感到焦虑、不安、愤怒，并认为自己不如同事
therapeutic_implications: 需要保护和支持工作者的心智化能力，通过加强其网络
atom.evidence_excerpt: In this field of work, there is perhaps a unique vulnerability to experiences of professional shame: “I feel anxious/upset/angry about this situation, not like my colleague H who always seems so calm; perhaps I’m a failure at this work?” Shame, in turn, tends to reduce help-seeking in a worker, rendering them even more vulnerable to isolation and further collapse of their fragile mentalizing capacity.
atom.extraction_notes: 原文明确描述了专业羞耻感及其影响。

atom.claim: 工作者一定程度的焦虑是完全适当的，是意料之中甚至值得欢迎的；在如此风险和复杂的情况下做出其他反应将表明一定程度的假装模式功能。
therapeutic_implications: 应正常化工作者的焦虑，而非视为失败
atom.evidence_excerpt: We argue that a degree of anxiety in a worker is perfectly appropriate; to be expected, welcomed, even. To react otherwise in situations of such risk and complexity would suggest a degree of ‘pretend mode’ functioning.
atom.extraction_notes: 原文明确将焦虑视为适当，并指出缺乏焦虑可能表明假装模式。

atoms.claim: 社会稀疏化（social thinning）是一种潜在脆弱性，其程度与个体获得良性心智化心智网络的减少直接相关。
therapeutic_implications: 评估并增强个体的社会支持网络
atoms.evidence_excerpt: another way to frame the General Psychopathology Factor referred to above is as a latent vulnerability that increases in direct relation to “social thinning” (McCrory, 2019), so that across time an individual, through neurodevelopmental vulnerability, trauma, or symptomatic illness, finds they have less and less access to benign and mentalizing minds.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确提及社会稀疏化与潜在脆弱性的关系。

atoms.claim: AMBIT 原则成对出现，彼此处于张力之中，共同描述工作者试图保持平衡的立场。
clinical_signals: 工作者在原则间感到矛盾
therapeutic_implications: 接受工作的不可能性
在原则间灵活调整
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Each of the four quadrants is associated with a pair of principles, which are always in tension with each other. Collectively these principles describe an AMBIT stance that a worker tries to hold in balance.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述AMBIT原则的成对性和张力。

atoms.claim: 母亲能够心智化其尖叫的婴儿，前提是她至少拥有一个其他心智网络的概念，这些心智能够理解并共情地再现她的痛苦和疲惫。
therapeutic_implications: 帮助母亲建立或识别支持网络
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The mother can only mentalize her screaming infant insofar as she has at least the idea of a network of other minds that can, would, or do hold her own mind in mind: her own mother, her partner, her friend, the health visitor, etc. - people who can construe and empathically represent (re-present) her own distress and exhaustion as understandable.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明母亲心智化婴儿需要心智网络的支持。

atoms.claim: AMBIT 强调与青少年建立关系，但同样重视工作者及其团队和网络的关系。
clinical_signals: 工作者过度关注青少年而忽视自身支持
therapeutic_implications: 平衡对青少年和工作者关系的关注
atoms.evidence_excerpt: AMBIT has its foundations in mentalizing and attachment theory (Bevington, Fuggle, & Fonagy, 2015), and thus there is a strong emphasis on the building of relationships, and the first one (inevitably) is the one with the young person. However, if it has anything substantively new to add, AMBIT seeks to shift attention toward equality of emphasis in its application toward the workers – across teams, and whole network or systems of help – as well as toward their clients.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明AMBIT对青少年和工作者关系的平等重视。

therapeutic_implications: 培训团队发展并维持平衡四个象限的本地文化

atom.claim: 专业羞耻感会减少工作者的求助行为，使其更易孤立并进一步损害其脆弱的心智化能力。
clinical_signals: 工作者感到焦虑、沮丧、愤怒
工作者认为自己是失败者
therapeutic_implications: 正常化工作者的焦虑
鼓励工作者寻求支持
atom.evidence_excerpt: Shame, in turn, tends to reduce help-seeking in a worker, rendering them even more vulnerable to isolation and further collapse of their fragile mentalizing capacity.
atom.extraction_notes: 明确描述羞耻感对工作者求助行为和心智化的影响。

atoms.claim: 关键工作者是当前在青少年心中具有“关键”地位的从业者，与青少年之间存在一定的认知信任，且这一角色可能随时间变化。
clinical_signals: 青少年与某工作者建立信任
therapeutic_implications: 识别并支持当前关键工作者
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The primary professional in contact with the client is referred to as the ‘keyworker’ in AMBIT, not necessarily being a formal role; it may simply be the worker who is currently “key” in the mind of the young person – with whom there is some epistemic trust – and in a network, this person may change over time.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了关键工作者的定义和特征。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 通过关键工作者视角看待帮助网络
atoms.canonical_name_en: Viewing helping network through client's eyes
atoms.claim: 关键工作者应不断尝试通过青少年的视角看待帮助网络，并以有助于塑造、排序和适应网络的方式行动。
therapeutic_implications: 工作者需从青少年视角评估帮助网络
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The keyworker in that sense constantly tries to view the helping network through the eyes of the client and to act in ways that help to shape, sequence, and adapt it productively.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述了关键工作者的这一视角。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 向青少年展示工作者自身的连接
atoms.claim: 关键工作者应向青少年展示他们与团队的联系，特别是他们从团队获得的帮助，以此示范寻求帮助是普遍的，并表明工作者是受支持、有连接且能信任同事建议的。
therapeutic_implications: 工作者应公开自己的支持网络，以促进青少年的信任和求助行为
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Keyworkers are encouraged to broadcast to their client an understanding of their own connections, particularly the help they receive from their own team, thus modelling to their clients that help-seeking is universal, and that ‘this worker is supported, connected and able to trust the advice of his colleagues’.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确鼓励关键工作者向青少年展示自身连接。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 邀请青少年思考帮助网络的调整
atoms.canonical_name_en: Inviting young person to think about helping network
atoms.claim: 通过展示工作者自身的连接，逐步邀请青少年思考如何调整和改善他们自己的帮助网络，使其更有用、可持续，并最终被体验为更有帮助。
therapeutic_implications: 逐步引导青少年参与帮助网络的调整
atoms.evidence_excerpt: In this way, over time, implicitly and then explicitly, the invitation to the young person is to think about how their own helping network (beyond this worker) might be adapted and helped to become more useful, sustainable, and ultimately to be experienced as more helpful.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了这一邀请过程。

atom.canonical_name_zh: 关键工作者与团队连接
atom.claim: 关键工作者必须与团队保持良好连接，以避免孤立，从而在情绪紧张的情境中维持最佳心智化实践。
therapeutic_implications: 支持工作者与团队保持连接，以促进心智化
atom.evidence_excerpt: The equal and “opposite” principle emphasises that such workers must remain “well-connected” to their team. The AMBIT approach aims to support generating and maintaining best (mentalizing) practice within such emotionally tense contexts, in which explicit mentalizing will be inhibited (Fonagy, Gergely, Jurist, & Target, 2004) unless the worker avoids isolation.
atom.extraction_notes: 明确陈述了关键工作者需与团队连接以避免孤立，从而维持心智化实践。

atom.canonical_name_zh: 早期阶段关键工作者的中心角色
atom.canonical_name_en: Central role of keyworker in early engagement
atom.claim: 在早期接触阶段，关键工作者在提供照顾和治疗方面可能扮演中心角色，有时是青少年和家庭的唯一直接联系人。
therapeutic_implications: 关键工作者需承担中心角色，避免其他工作者过早直接接触
contraindications: 其他工作者在早期阶段直接接触可能使青少年不堪重负
atom.evidence_excerpt: In the early stages of engagement, the keyworker may often have quite a central role in providing care and treatment/help for the young person and their existing helping network. In cases where the keyworker acts as a case manager, they may sometimes be the only direct contact with the young person and family. Direct approaches by additional workers, however well-intentioned, may in the early stages overwhelm the young persons’ capacity for affiliative bonding.
atom.extraction_notes: 明确描述了早期阶段关键工作者的中心角色和其他工作者直接接触的潜在负面影响。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 通过关键工作者视角看待帮助网络
atoms.canonical_name_en: Viewing helping network through the eyes of the client
atoms.claim: 关键工作者应不断尝试通过青少年的视角看待帮助网络，并采取行动帮助塑造、排序和适应它。

therapeutic_implications: 帮助青少年更好地理解和利用帮助网络
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The keyworker in that sense constantly tries to view the helping network through the eyes of the client and to act in ways that help to shape, sequence, and adapt it productively.

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 透明化帮助关系的暂时性
atoms.canonical_name_en: Transparency about temporary nature of helping relationship
atoms.claim: 对帮助关系暂时性的透明化，有时对于成功接触青少年至关重要。
clinical_signals: 青少年对专业人员保持距离
therapeutic_implications: 可能促进青少年参与
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Transparency about the temporary nature of this helping relationship, can (paradoxically) sometimes be critical to success in engaging a young person, alongside shared goal setting.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明透明化暂时性的重要性。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化青少年现有的帮助网络
atoms.claim: 关键工作者帮助青少年心智化其现有的帮助网络，作为展示工作者团队支持的直接平行过程。

therapeutic_implications: 促进青少年对帮助网络的理解和利用
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The keyworker helps a young person to mentalize their existing helping network (as a direct parallel to showing them the team that supports the keyworker, and the benefits of being able to “phone a friend”.)

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化而非忽视有害关系
atoms.claim: 在早期接触阶段，关键工作者必须首先心智化青少年与有害帮助者（如毒贩）的关系，而不是直接否定。
clinical_signals: 青少年与有害帮助者（如毒贩）有联系
therapeutic_implications: 避免过早否定，先理解关系功能
atoms.evidence_excerpt: in the early stages of engagement, it is critical that these relationships are first mentalized, and not dismissed out of hand.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明对有害关系应先心智化。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 标记专业义务和长期意图
atoms.canonical_name_en: Marking professional obligations and longer-term intentions
atoms.claim: 在需要积极风险管理时，工作者需要努力标记其专业义务和长期意图，以及认识到干预的侵入性。
therapeutic_implications: 减少侵入性干预的负面影响
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Where active risk management is required, significant efforts need to go into “marking” the fact of our professional obligations, and our longer-term intentions, as well as our recognition of how intrusive this can seem.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述标记专业义务和意图。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 在青少年现有世界中运作
atoms.canonical_name_en: Operating within the young person's existing world
atoms.claim: 工作者应尝试在青少年现有的世界中运作，并参与他们实际体验为有帮助或无帮助的现实。
clinical_signals: 青少年对正式治疗抵触
therapeutic_implications: 通过解决实际问题（如与教练的争执）来促进参与
atoms.evidence_excerpt: the worker tries to operate within the young person’s existing world and to engage with the reality of what they experience as helpful and unhelpful.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述在青少年现有世界中运作。

atom.canonical_name_zh: 关键工作者与团队连接
atom.canonical_name_en: Keyworker well connected with the team
atom.claim: 关键工作者必须与团队保持良好连接，以避免孤立，从而在情绪紧张的情境中维持最佳心智化实践。
therapeutic_implications: 支持工作者在情绪紧张情境中维持心智化实践
atom.evidence_excerpt: The AMBIT approach aims to support generating and maintaining best (mentalizing) practice within such emotionally tense contexts, in which explicit mentalizing will be inhibited (Fonagy, Gergely, Jurist, & Target, 2004) unless the worker avoids isolation. A “well-connected team” holds an enculturated set of social disciplines that are based on mentalizing (ways of asking for help, ways of reaching out to one another) to support each other’s individual work, minimising the risk of isolation or the pressure to be a “solo mentalizing ninja”.
atom.extraction_notes: 明确说明团队连接对维持心智化实践的作用。

atom.claim: 当青少年被转介到照护系统时，工作重点应尽快修复亲社会网络支持。
clinical_signals: 社会网络崩溃，青少年与支持分离
therapeutic_implications: 尽快恢复亲社会支持
atom.evidence_excerpt: The work is thus focused on repairing pro-social network supports as soon as possible.
atom.extraction_notes: 明确说明修复亲社会网络支持。

atoms.claim: 对帮助关系的临时性保持透明，有时对成功吸引年轻人至关重要。
clinical_signals: 年轻人对专业人员保持警惕
therapeutic_implications: 明确关系的临时性
共同设定目标
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Transparency about the temporary nature of this helping relationship, can (paradoxically) sometimes be critical to success in engaging a young person, alongside shared goal setting.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述，适用于青少年人群。

atoms.claim: 关键工作者帮助年轻人心智化其现有的帮助网络，这直接类似于向年轻人展示支持关键工作者的团队以及“打电话给朋友”的好处。
clinical_signals: 年轻人对现有帮助网络缺乏认识
therapeutic_implications: 探索并理解年轻人现有的帮助来源
培养谦逊和真实的态度
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The keyworker helps a young person to mentalize their existing helping network (as a direct parallel to showing them the team that supports the keyworker, and the benefits of being able to “phone a friend”.)
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述，适用于青少年。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化而非否定有害帮助者
atoms.canonical_name_en: Mentalizing rather than dismissing harmful helpers
atoms.claim: 在早期接触阶段，对于来自极具挑战背景的年轻客户，其现有“帮助者”（如毒贩、帮派头目）的关系必须首先被心智化，而不是立即否定。
clinical_signals: 年轻人有来自挑战背景的有害帮助者
therapeutic_implications: 首先心智化这些关系
不立即否定
atoms.evidence_excerpt: in the early stages of engagement, it is critical that these relationships are first mentalized, and not dismissed out of hand.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述，适用于青少年。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 在年轻人现有世界中运作
atoms.canonical_name_en: Operating within the young person's existing world
atoms.claim: 有时在正式治疗开始前，最有帮助的做法是帮助解决与体育教练的争执，以便训练能够恢复，从而在年轻人现有的世界中运作。
clinical_signals: 与体育教练等现有支持者发生冲突
therapeutic_implications: 帮助解决现有关系中的冲突
参与年轻人认为有帮助的现实
atoms.evidence_excerpt: sometimes before anything that looks like more formal therapy starts, the most helpful manoeuvre is to help settle an argument with the sports-coach, so that training can resume. In this way, the worker tries to operate within the young person’s existing world and to engage with the reality of what they experience as helpful and unhelpful.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述，适用于青少年。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 标记专业义务和侵入性
atoms.claim: 在需要积极风险管理时，需要付出巨大努力来“标记”我们的专业义务、长期意图以及我们认识到这可能显得多么侵入。
therapeutic_implications: 标记专业义务
标记长期意图
承认侵入性
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Where active risk management is required, significant efforts need to go into “marking” the fact of our professional obligations, and our longer-term intentions, as well as our recognition of how intrusive this can seem.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述，适用于青少年。

atoms.claim: 关键工作者应积极介入并负责帮助整合不同领域的干预措施，通过帮助不同工作者彼此心智化，以及心智化年轻人或其照顾者。
clinical_signals: 多专业多机构网络中的冲突观点
therapeutic_implications: 帮助不同工作者彼此心智化
帮助心智化年轻人或照顾者
atoms.evidence_excerpt: The keyworker is expected to actively engage with and is responsible for trying to help integrate, the different interventions within these domains - by helping the different workers to mentalize one another as well as the young person or their carers.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述，适用于青少年。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 避免具体组织结构的建议
atoms.claim: AMBIT避免关于组织结构的具体（目的论）建议，因为当地文化和服务提供背景会深刻影响这些。
clinical_signals: 需要灵活适应本地环境
therapeutic_implications: 避免具体组织结构建议
考虑当地文化和服务背景
atoms.evidence_excerpt: AMBIT avoids concrete (teleological) recommendations about organisational structures, as local cultures and service delivery contexts will deeply influence these.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述，适用于青少年。

Struggles and concerns present in all kind of domains (“from the molecular to the political”), all interconnected. AMBIT requires a “wide-angle lens” of workers, to ensure that there is work occurring in all those domains, when and where this is required.

therapeutic_implications: 注重团队建设和连接

atom.canonical_name_zh: 尊重循证实践与本地实践证据
atom.canonical_name_en: Respect for evidence and local practice
atom.claim: 使用AMBIT意味着必须尊重和使用循证实践，同时也要认识到本地实践证据的重要性，并平衡两者。
therapeutic_implications: 结合循证实践和本地实践证据
atom.evidence_excerpt: Using AMBIT means realising that it is essential to respect and use evidence-based practices. ... Evidence-based practice will be complemented by locally held “practice-based evidence” that will be attuned to local culture, and service contexts.

therapeutic_implications: 在缺乏稳健临床研究的情况下，应结合当地实践证据来调整干预措施。

atoms.canonical_name_en: Working under the influence of AMBIT

therapeutic_implications: 实施应灵活适应本地情境，而非严格遵循固定模式。

atoms.extraction_notes: 明确强调适应性实施而非标准化复制。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 团队反思与共同识别挑战
atoms.canonical_name_en: Team reflection to identify challenging areas
atoms.claim: 团队应共同反思，识别其实际经验中反复挑战他们的领域，并确定哪些方面可以改进。
therapeutic_implications: 培训前应进行团队反思，以确定具体需求。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: teams considering training are invited and supported to reflect together to identify actual areas of their lived experience that repeatedly challenge them, and which could be improved.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确要求团队共同反思以识别挑战领域。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化态度：好奇与避免假设
atoms.canonical_name_en: Mentalizing attitude of searching and tentative curiosity
atoms.claim: 基本的心智化态度是探索性和试探性的好奇心，避免假设知识脱离证据（假装模式）。
therapeutic_implications: 临床工作者应保持好奇，避免过早下结论。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: This is in accordance with the basic mentalizing attitude of a searching and tentative curiosity, avoiding the assumption of knowledge that is unmoored to evidence (pretend mode).
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确将探索性好奇心与避免假装模式联系起来。

atoms.claim: 假装模式是指假设知识脱离证据，应避免。
therapeutic_implications: 干预应基于证据，避免脱离现实的假设。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: avoiding the assumption of knowledge that is unmoored to evidence (pretend mode).
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确将脱离证据的假设定义为假装模式。

atoms.claim: AMBIT并非一刀切的方案，而是基于证据和积累的临床经验的方法。
therapeutic_implications: 实施时应根据具体情境调整，而非机械套用。
atoms.evidence_excerpt: AMBIT is designed not as a ‘one size fits all’ package, but as an approach based on evidence and accumulated clinical experience from training several thousand workers over the past decade.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确否定一刀切，强调基于证据和经验。

atom.canonical_name_zh: 瓦解网格促进多专业心智化
atom.claim: 瓦解网格是一种简单技术，通过邀请对三个层面（解释、干预、责任）进行心智化，支持跨专业或跨机构网络中的系统性心智化。
therapeutic_implications: 可用于协调多机构合作，减少分裂。
atom.evidence_excerpt: A simple technique to support systematic mentalization across a multi-professional or multi-agency network that appears to be “pulling in different directions” is the Dis-integration grid.
atom.extraction_notes: 明确描述瓦解网格作为支持系统性心智化的技术。

atoms.claim: 团队应共同反思其实际经验中反复出现的挑战领域，并确定可改进之处，而非将培训目标定义为“实践AMBIT”。
therapeutic_implications: 培训应基于团队实际挑战
使用在线资源如ASEQ进行评估
atoms.evidence_excerpt: teams considering training are invited and supported to reflect together to identify actual areas of their lived experience that repeatedly challenge them, and which could be improved.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了培训前反思的重要性。

atoms.canonical_name_zh: 心智化网络中的不同立场
atoms.claim: 在解离网格中，努力代表各参与者的理解（而非强加自己的观点），例如年轻人可能将“问题”视为我们这类人的侵入，若否认或忽视这一点，则难以开展有帮助的工作。
clinical_signals: 专业人员与年轻人对问题定义不一致
therapeutic_implications: 承认并理解年轻人的视角
避免否认或忽视其感受
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Sometimes the “problem” as a young person sees it, is the intrusion of people like us. If this is denied, or ignored, little helpful work will ensue.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了年轻人视角的重要性。

atoms.claim: 在共同思考的第三步“心智化当下”中，首先心智化求助的同事（而非来访者），这是帮助被接受和消化的前提。
clinical_signals: 督导中急于关注来访者而忽略同事状态
therapeutic_implications: 先与求助同事建立调谐
再共同心智化问题中的其他心智
atoms.evidence_excerpt: First the helping colleague(s) mentalize the help-seeking colleague (not the client, which is tempting, but they are not present); this is the pre-requisite for any help that might be offered being accepted and digested.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了步骤顺序和原理。

atoms.claim: 任何咨询开始时需澄清咨询师被问及的内容以及要解决的问题，避免直接开始谈话导致缺乏焦点。
therapeutic_implications: 帮助求助者心智化自己（为何此时求助）
帮助咨询师明确倾听目的
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mark the task: any consultation starts with a clarification of what is asked from the consultant, what is the problem to be addressed?
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了第一步的目的。

atoms.claim: 在共同思考的第二步，咨询师或小组需提供解决任务所需的基本案例信息，咨询师负责监控是否陷入“讲故事”（假装模式）。
clinical_signals: 案例讨论陷入冗长叙述
therapeutic_implications: 保持信息聚焦
避免假装模式
atoms.evidence_excerpt: State the case: here, the consultant or group is provided with the bones of the case, the information that is needed to resolve the task. The consultant is responsible for monitoring whether we are falling into ‘storytelling’ (pretend mode), or when enough info seems to be present.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了第二步的内容和监控责任。

atoms.claim: 在共同思考的最后一步，当工作者被心智化且问题得到一定心智化后，考虑如何将心智化转化为实践行动。
clinical_signals: 心智化后缺乏行动方向
therapeutic_implications: 将心智化成果应用于实践
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Return to purpose: finally, when the worker is mentalized and some mentalizing has occurred around the problem, there is room for considering
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了第四步的目的，但原文句子未完整，根据上下文补充。

therapeutic_implications: 帮助识别误解所在的层面
激发好奇心以理解更多
促进连接性对话

atom.canonical_name_zh: 共同思考（而非各自思考）
atom.claim: 共同思考是AMBIT核心中的主要督导技术，通过四个步骤（标记任务、陈述案例、心智化当下、回归目的）结构化咨询或督导过程。
clinical_signals: 团队内寻求帮助时缺乏焦点
therapeutic_implications: 明确咨询任务
避免陷入故事讲述（假装模式）
先心智化求助同事而非来访者
atom.evidence_excerpt: This is the main supervision technique in the AMBIT core. ... “Thinking together” structures how all consultation or supervision (help-seeking between team members) is conducted, by defining four steps: 1 Mark the task ... 2 State the case ... 3 Mentalizing the moment ... 4 Return to purpose
atom.extraction_notes: 明确描述了技术步骤和目的。

atoms.claim: 在思考在一起的第三步，帮助同事首先心智化寻求帮助的同事（而非来访者），这是任何帮助被接受和消化的前提。
clinical_signals: 帮助者感到未被理解或支持
therapeutic_implications: 确保帮助者感到被调谐，从而能够接受帮助
response_constraints: 先心智化同事，而非直接关注来访者
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mentalizing the moment: First the helping colleague(s) mentalize the help-seeking colleague (not the client, which is tempting, but they are not present); this is the pre-requisite for any help that might be offered being accepted and digested.
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明心智化同事是帮助被接受的前提。

atoms.claim: 任何咨询开始时需澄清咨询师被问及的问题以及要解决的任务，这有助于帮助者明确焦点，并促使寻求帮助者开始心智化自己。
clinical_signals: 咨询开始时缺乏明确焦点
帮助者不清楚为何或听什么
therapeutic_implications: 帮助寻求帮助者心智化自己的需求
response_constraints: 在开始讨论前明确任务
atoms.evidence_excerpt: Mark the task: any consultation starts with a clarification of what is asked from the consultant, what is the problem to be addressed? We tend just to start talking, which leaves the helper without a clear focus on why or what they are listening for, and the help-seeker without having made a start by mentalizing themselves (“why am I approaching H just now? What do I want or need?”)
atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了标记任务的目的和效果。

atoms.claim: 在思考在一起的第二步，咨询师或团队需提供解决任务所需的基本案例信息，咨询师负责监控是否陷入‘讲故事’（假装模式）或信息是否足够。
